title: Had more vivid dreams after IRL food poisoning..
content: So I had IRL food poisoning from fast food on Weds and I basically had to purge my system of everything...caffeine, sugar, anti anxiety meds and been on crackers and soup and water mostly. Ever since then my dreams have been 10x more vivid.. Had a mall world dream that was pretty similar to things ppl mentioned here. Escalators everywhere, dirty toilets with no doors on them, a movie theatre on the main floor, random parking lot underground. Has anyone ever seen a smoking area on the top floor going outside? The shape of the place was very circular. Has anyone ever experienced more vivid dreams after purging nonsense from their system?
